bull_argument.argument:
SunCon retains a reported RM10.5bn backlog and current profit growth despite the downgrade narrative. Positive operating earnings and moderate gross debt/equity support the view that future-margin concerns are distinct from an established collapse in earning capacity.

At 22.34x trailing earnings, the strongest buy case requires sustainable margins and conversion rather than extrapolating exceptional FCF. The oversold breakdown is still unconfirmed, so selective exposure is conditional on updated economics and completed-session stabilization. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
22.34x trailing earnings still needs sustainable project margins despite current profit resilience. Backlog does not guarantee conversion, and FCF at 4.35 times snapshot profit needs working-capital reconciliation.

The heavy-volume September 11 breakdown extends into a provisional new-session low; oversold RSI and remaining above SMA200 do not establish a bottom. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
